name: o57229

_$id.description: Name of a user created collection's schema

description: The system defines a custom collection identified by the name **com.example.userCollections**. Within this collection there are two principal fields. The first, called **User Profile**, is classified as a document type; it carries a title of “User Profile”, enforces a maximum length of 255 characters, is flagged as required (“true”), and defaults to an active status. The second field, **User Settings**, is a configuration type with the title “User Settings”; its values set the theme to dark, enable notifications (value 1), and limit the view to 20 items per page.
